Danil "'''donk'''" Kryshkovets {{born}} is a [[:Category:Russia|Russian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who plays for [[Team Spirit]] as an entry fragger. He is widely considered as one of the best riflers in the world ever since his breakthrough in late 2023, being named the best player of 2024 and the runner-up for the best player in 2025. <ref name="top24"/><ref name="top25"/> In addition, he has won 13 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, including an MVP from a [[Majors|Major Championship]].

In 2024, his rookie year, donk would sweep the [[HLTV/Awards_Show|HLTV Awards]] winning Rookie, Opener, Highlight and Player of the year.

===Records===
*Most [[HLTV/MVP_Awards|HLTV MVP awards]] from a player's first full year of professional play (5).
**Tied with [[ZywOo]].
*Highest achieved rating at a "Big Event": 1.79 ([[Intel Extreme Masters/2024/Katowice|IEM Katowice 2024]]) <ref name="Kato MVP"/>
**The tournament was also his debut S-Tier LAN event and an HLTV Super-Elite event.
**The original rating at the time of the event had been 1.70, tied with [[NiKo]], however HLTV's future updates to the rating have since changed the value.
*Highest achieved rating at a [[Majors|Major]]: 1.48 ([[Perfect_World/Major/2024/Shanghai|PW Shanghai Major 2024]]) <ref name="Shanghai MVP"/>
**The original rating at the time of the event had been 1.49, however HLTV's future updates to the rating have since changed the value.
*Youngest player to:
**Win a [[Majors|Major]]: 17 years, 324 days ([[Perfect_World/Major/2024/Shanghai|PW Shanghai Major 2024]])
**Be named the [[HLTV/MVP_Awards|HLTV MVP]] of a [[Majors|Major]]: 17 years, 324 days ([[Perfect_World/Major/2024/Shanghai|PW Shanghai Major 2024]]) <ref name="Shanghai MVP"/>
**Be named the [[HLTV/MVP_Awards|HLTV MVP]] of a "Big Event": 17 years, 17 days ([[Intel Extreme Masters/2024/Katowice|IEM Katowice 2024]]) <ref name="Kato MVP"/>
**Be ranked first on [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year]] ranking: 17 years, 352 days.
*2nd youngest player to be named the [[HLTV/MVP_Awards|HLTV MVP]]: 16 years, 320 days ([[BetBoom Dacha/2023/Dubai|BetBoom Dacha Dubai 2023]]) <ref name="Dacha MVP"/>
*Most aces at a "Big Event" and at a [[Majors|Major]]: 4 ([[Perfect_World/Major/2024/Shanghai|PW Shanghai Major 2024]]) <ref name="Shanghai MVP"/>
**Tied with [[s1mple]] in the former.
